entries.0e2c37222d571d97: The annual securities report states that, from a desire to create Internet services that enrich individuals' lifestyles, it saw a business opportunity in manga-related business while operating various apps. This management philosophy is still set out in its management policy.
entries.0f898234d9e602c2: In the freemium section of "Manga BANG!", manga can basically be read free of charge, and users who pay can rent manga for 72 hours or buy it for about ¥40 to ¥100 per 1 episode. There is also a "Store" section where e-books can be bought 1 volume at a time. To differentiate its own app and layer its revenue, the company also focuses on producing original manga, and in February 2025 it launched the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo". In the IT Solutions Business, Amazia Link Co., Ltd. operates SES, an SEO media and a point-earning app.

entries.158d8d641db593cd: This covers the planning and operation of the freemium manga apps "Manga BANG!" and "Manga Tote" and the Web e-book service "Manga BANG Books," and manga production under the label "Manga BANG Comics." The overseas version "MANGA BANG!" is handled by Amazia Link Inc., and WEBTOON production by the non-consolidated subsidiary WithLinks Inc. "Manga BANG!" is free in principle and rests on 2 models: a "per-episode payment plus advertising revenue model," earning revenue from small payments for 1 episode at a time and from advertising, and a "purchase model (store)," in which e-books are bought 1 book at a time. The securities report does not state this business's sales on its own.

entries.70184050556c9bdf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,843,175 thousand (down 20.7% year on year). By reportable segment, the Entertainment Business recorded ¥2,792,398 thousand (down 22.1% year on year), and the IT Solutions Business ¥50,777 thousand. The annual securities report states that both billing revenue and advertising revenue decreased, due to a decline in MAU from reduced advertising and promotion expenses and a fall in advertising revenue per unit. Because customers purchase and use coins, the company records coins as contract liabilities when they are granted, and recognizes revenue when coins are used to purchase content.

entries.74232ebf9a1ade4d: Operating loss for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥361,169 thousand (¥400,612 thousand in the previous fiscal year), ordinary loss was ¥357,578 thousand (¥403,486 thousand), and net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥372,270 thousand (¥589,444 thousand). Cost of sales was ¥2,267,268 thousand (down 13.6% year on year), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥937,076 thousand (down 31.3%), with advertising and promotion expenses kept to ¥332,238 thousand (down 56.2%). The annual securities report states that the company set this period as a period of advance investment, pursuing profit securing in the Entertainment Business and investment in the IT Solutions Business and others. Cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2025 were ¥460,589 thousand, down ¥467,920 thousand from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year.
